answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a wharf as the anchor of the cost. A shale stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a jade holds the rep...
